# What is validated

<!-- Generated by docs/gen_validated.py from docs/validated.toml. Do not edit by hand. -->

This is the one table of what queuetruth has checked, and on what. Every other page links here instead of
keeping its own list. A claim is only as strong as its row: real data means real public market files,
fixtures mean files written from public format documents, not real exports.

## Validated on real data

| Area | What was checked | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Nasdaq TotalView-ITCH 5.0: exact book, shadow orders and scorer | 2 public days (2019-12-30 and 2020-01-30; AAPL, MSFT, SPY, TSLA) read from the raw ITCH bytes: 0 book invariant violations over 16,754,562 records and 0 trade-parity mismatches over 633,287 printed executions. An independent matching-engine oracle agrees with the exact fill rule on 3,000 of 3,000 shadow orders on both days. 3,000 real orders per day used as a live log are reproduced exactly by the scorer's exact arm. | [Results](RESULTS.md#the-headline-number), [Real-data checks](testing.md#real-data-checks) |
| IEX DEEP+: exact book on every atlas day | 24 public days replayed by the Fill-Realism Atlas pipeline; the published 20-day window is 2026-10-15 to 2026-11-11 (265,351 symbol-days, 12,456 symbols). Every symbol-day's replay is checked for the eight book invariants, price priority and trade parity, and a symbol-day with any non-zero check is left out of the published numbers. On one day (2026-10-09; SPY, AAPL, NVDA, TSLA; 4,435,281 records) all 21,301 displayed executions were also at FIFO rank 0 of their price level. | [The Fill-Realism Atlas](concepts/fill-realism-atlas.md), [A real day from free IEX data](how-to/iex-public-demo.md) |
| Calibration and the learned fill model | Fitted on one public Nasdaq day and scored on the other: `p = 0.29` for NautilusTrader's touch model cuts the held-out day's 1 s overfill from +2.8 pp to +0.4 pp. Exports refuse a fit that does not beat the library default on held-out data. | [Results](RESULTS.md#the-headline-number), [Calibration](concepts/calibration.md) |

## Checked against the library

| Area | What was checked | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| NautilusTrader fill models | The faithful `nt_prob_touch`, `nt_queue_l2` and `nt_queue_l2_prob_touch` agree with nautilus_trader 1.231.0's `BacktestEngine` (fed `OrderBookDelta`s) on 100% of orders at 1 s, 10 s and 60 s on both Nasdaq days and the synthetic fixture. On 2.0.0rc7 the touch model fills the same orders and `nt_queue_l2` agrees on 99.60% to 100% of orders per day and horizon. Fed `OrderBookDepth10` snapshots, 1.231.0 behaves differently (see Results). | [NautilusTrader cross-check](RESULTS.md#nautilustrader-cross-check), [How it is tested](testing.md#real-data-checks) |
| hftbacktest queue models | The faithful models are bit-exact against a line-by-line transliteration of hftbacktest's source; the transliteration matches hftbacktest 2.4.4 on every recorded queue-model call. | [The L2 model zoo](concepts/l2-model-zoo.md), [Oracle list](testing.md#oracle-list) |

## From public documentation only

| Area | What was checked | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Databento queue-position model | Re-implemented from Databento's public tutorial; not checked against Databento's own code. | [The L2 model zoo](concepts/l2-model-zoo.md) |

## Fixtures and synthetic data only

| Area | What was checked | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Databento DBN and CME | Synthetic data only. The reader also reads Databento's public DBN test files, which checks decoding, not CME queue semantics. | [Venue semantics](venue-semantics.md), [Databento MBO](how-to/databento-mbo.md) |
| Crypto order-level readers | Rules assumed from venue documentation. Bitstamp and Bitfinex: one 10-minute capture each replays with every invariant 0 (counters only, not fill fidelity). Coinbase, Kraken and Hyperliquid: fixtures only. | [Crypto order-level feeds](how-to/crypto-l3-sources.md), [Venue semantics](venue-semantics.md) |
| NYSE TAQ Integrated Feed | Hand-written and generated files only; no real NYSE file has been replayed. | [NYSE order-by-order data](how-to/nyse-order-level.md) |
| Trading halts outside ITCH and IEX | Halts are recorded from Nasdaq ITCH and IEX DEEP+ on real data. The DBN `status` and NYSE Security Status readers (since 0.3.0) are tested on fixtures only; crypto sources record no halts. | [Venue semantics](venue-semantics.md) |
| Live-log importers and backtest importers | Every venue and broker importer (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Coinbase, Kraken, Deribit, Hyperliquid, IBKR Flex, FIX drop copies, QuickFIX logs) and every backtest importer (hftbacktest, NautilusTrader, Freqtrade, Hummingbot, Backtrader, VectorBT, LEAN) is tested on fixtures written from public format documents and the engines' sources. No real account export has been imported. | [Import fills from my venue or broker](how-to/import-live-logs.md) |
| Prediction-market kit | Kalshi and Polymarket readers and queue models tested on invented captures in the documented message formats only; no real venue capture has been replayed. | [Prediction-market making](how-to/prediction-market-making.md) |
| Forecast referee | Tested on synthetic worlds in which the right answer is known; no real forecasts. | [Score forecasts](how-to/score-forecasts.md) |

Exact truth covers displayed liquidity on FIFO venues. It does not model your own order's impact on others,
hidden or iceberg liquidity, auctions or pro-rata matching. How each check runs:
[How queuetruth is tested](testing.md).
